$ cat README.md
# demo-tool

Install the CLI:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://demo.example.com/install.sh | bash
export PATH="$HOME/.demo/bin:$PATH"
demo --version
```

Quickstart:

```python
from demo import Client

c = Client()
c.panes()
```

One-liner config:

```
set -gx DEMO_HOME ~/.config/demo
```

Tilde fences work too:

~~~
herdr config set theme macchiato
herdr config show
~~~

(This next fence is never closed — it must not extract, and it must
not swallow anything after it:)

~~~ruby
this tilde fence never closes

Here is the pi block from the wild:

╭· fish ·····································╮
│   cd ~/.dotfiles/dotSrc/app_coding_agents  │
│   git checkout feat/demo-s5                │
│                                            │
│   # 1. Temp workspace                      │
╰············································╯

A boxed, numbered listing (box wins, numbers strip with it):

╭─────────────────╮
│   1 │ cd ~/x    │
│   2 │ git pull  │
╰─────────────────╯

A codegen CLI snippet frame (the fences inside are box *content*):

╭─ snippet ────────╮
│ ```sh           │
│ demo run --all  │
│ ```             │
╰─────────────────╯

bat output:

   1 │ herdr plugin pane open --placement popup
   2 │ herdr --version
  10 │ herdr doctor

rg multi-file:

src/main.rs:12:fn main() {
src/main.rs:13:    println!("hi");
src/main.rs:14:}

Look-alikes — none of these may extract as blocks:

| key | value |
|-----|-------|
| a   | 1     |

+--------+
|  art   |
+--------+

12: this is code
5: more code
99: more code

3 apples
4 pears
